professionalService.problemSolved: Helps an architect explain how one hillside house connects its street, bedroom and garden levels through the stair while retaining the section as the common spatial reference.
professionalService.serviceOutcome: A measured section gains depth and material, the camera descends from street kitchen through bedroom and living levels to the pool, then returns to the whole material section.
professionalService.decisionValue: Supports discussion of circulation, level relationships, daylight and the route from street to garden. The house and level numbers are donor-authored examples.

evidence.statement: PLAN.c encodes the distinct descending path and chapter copy.

continuityInvariants.statement: One stair connects the same street, bedroom and garden-level slabs throughout the descent.
The same terrace and pool remain beyond the living room before and after pullback.
Portrait left and right frames are contiguous views of the same returned section.
